description: This file defines the class 'actionComputeField' which extends 'actionBase'. It provides functionality for computing dynamic fields in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including methods for loading JavaScript, executing computations based on formulas, resolving parameters and related entities, and rendering UI components for configuring compute fields within workflows.

classes.name: actionComputeField
classes.description: A class for managing computed fields within SuiteCRM workflows, including UI rendering and formula application logic.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript files needed for this action's UI components.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the formula calculations and updates the bean accordingly, saving changes if in save context.

methods.name: resolveParameters
methods.description: Resolves parameters for formula calculation based on field values and types.

methods.name: getMultiEnumTranslated
methods.description: Translates multi-enum field values into human-readable strings.

methods.name: getArrayFromParams
methods.description: Extracts array elements from the provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveRelationParameters
methods.description: Resolves related entity parameters for formula calculations.

methods.name: getAllRelatedFields
methods.description: Retrieves all 'relate' type fields from a bean.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Renders the HTML UI for configuring compute fields, including parameters, relations, and formulas.

methods.name: getModuleFieldsDropdown
methods.description: Generates an HTML dropdown with module fields.

methods.name: getOneRelationOptions
methods.description: Builds options for relation selection in the UI.

methods.name: getOneRelations
methods.description: Returns a list of 'one' type relationships for the bean.

methods.name: getRelationDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves relationship definitions for a specific relation.

methods.name: getOppositeModule
methods.description: Determines the opposite module in a relationship.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates labels, attempting different contexts for localization.

methods.name: getRelationParameterFieldSelect
methods.description: Creates an HTML select element for relation property selection.

methods.name: createOptions
methods.description: Creates HTML options for dropdowns, sorted by module and relation.

methods.name: createJavascriptArrayFromParams
methods.description: Converts parameters into JavaScript array syntax for frontend use.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Generates an option element for a relation.

methods.name: getOtherModuleForRelationship
methods.description: Fetches the related module name for a relationship from the database.
